scope: Full small bootstrap-emitter read, focused on MP-substitution reconstruction and direct proof checking. No producer or compiler invocation, no full guarded-suffix review.
checks: Original proof parents strictly precede each emitted MP-substitution node
Normalized major consequent is injectively renamed to stated target
Same rename is applied to both premises; only absent conclusion variables default to truth0
Direct premise applications normalize only the exact wim00 alias and assert major=(minor,target)
All-natural bound witnesses use only zero/reflexivity/subterm le_l/le_r
The generator remains untrusted; Lean must check every emitted lemma and exact target
